newsitem.title: HONG KONG: China Res shares flat despite net surge.
newsitem.headline: China Res shares flat despite net surge.

text.p: Shares of China Resources Enterprise Ltd were little unchanged in Tuesday morning trade despite the company reporting a 109 percent rise in 1996 profit.
"The company earnings were actually weaker than the market expected if we took out the exceptional items," said a sales manager at a local brokerage.
"The shares were also very expensive in view of its high P/E (price/earnings) multiple of about 76 times," he added.
China Resources shares were down HK$0.05 at HK$20.10 in late morning after touching a high of HK$20.50. Volume was 2.4 million shares worth HK$48.5 million.

China Resources said its 1996 profit was HK$596.67 million, including an exceptional gain of HK$203.55 million linked to the flotation of its subsidiary China Resources Beijing Land Ltd in November 1996.

"As China plays are still in demand, it (China Resources) is expected to have a limited downside on hopes of asset acquisition which will boost its earnings base in future," said a dealing director at a regional brokerage.
